provider_config.title: Translation providers
provider_config.subtitle: Connect a machine translation provider to speed up review.
provider_config.beta_hint: This provider has not been tested against the real API yet. Use the connection test and review the first results carefully.
provider_config.ollama_model_hint: Test the connection to list available models
provider_config.ollama_no_models: No models found on this server
provider_config.ollama_connection_failed: Connection failed — check the server URL
provider_config.ollama_reliability_hint: Local models, especially heavily quantized ones or on modest hardware, can sometimes mix up short, similar labels (menus, buttons) within the same batch. Review AI suggestions before validating.
provider_config.ollama_batch_size_hint: Bigger is faster, smaller is more reliable. Leave empty to use the default.
provider_config.ollama_batch_size_invalid: Must be a whole number between {min} and {max}
provider_config.libretranslate_public_warning: Public instances have unpredictable rate limits. Self-hosting is recommended.
provider_config.libretranslate_cleartext_warning: This URL uses http:// to a non-local host — your API key will be sent unencrypted. Use https:// or a local address instead.
provider_config.libretranslate_api_key_hint: Optional — required only on private instances
provider_config.verbose_logging_hint: Prints detailed connection info to the console — useful when a provider isn't working.
provider_config.keyring_unavailable: Could not save the API key: no system keyring is available on this machine.

translation.cancelling_hint: Waiting for the current request to finish…
translation.job_running: A translation is already running. Cancel it first.
translation.ollama_slow_hint: Local models can be slow, especially on the first request.
translation.no_provider_configured: Configure a translation provider in settings first
translation.connection_ok: Connection OK — {chars} characters available this month
translation.connection_failed: Connection failed — check your API key
translation.unsupported_language: Automatic translation isn't available for '{lang}' (not a language recognized by providers)
translation.include_drafts_message: {n} line(s) hold an unvalidated draft. Retranslating overwrites their current text.

characters.title: Universe characters
characters.subtitle: Manage the character glossary used to give context to AI translation.
characters.purpose_speaker: They tell the model who is speaking, so a line gets the right gender and the right level of politeness.
characters.purpose_names: They keep every occurrence of a name translated the same way, the DeepL glossary included.
characters.purpose_notes: Their notes carry what the text never says out loud: register, relationships, a character's own turns of phrase.
characters.confirm_clear_all_message: {n} character(s) and their notes will be removed. Auto-detect can find the characters again, but never the notes: gender, register and the entries feeding the DeepL glossary are lost for good.

universe.title: Universe summary
universe.placeholder: Describe the game's setting, tone, and key themes…
universe.hint: This text is sent to the LLM before every translation batch.
universe.generate_no_llm: Configure an LLM provider (Ollama, Claude, Mistral) to enable AI generation.
universe.generate_confirm_title: Send game dialogue to an AI provider?
universe.generate_confirm_message: A sample of the game's dialogue will be sent to {provider} to write the summary. Continue?
universe.generate_done: Summary generated — review it, then save.
universe.generate_failed: Generation failed — check the provider configuration.
universe.generate_no_units: No extracted text to analyze — extract the game first.
universe.purpose_tone: It settles the tone and register: a solemn game and a comedy do not translate alike.
universe.purpose_names: It says which proper nouns stay as they are and which ones get translated.
universe.purpose_terms: It supplies the game's own vocabulary (places, items, factions), which the model cannot guess.
universe.generate_desc: A sample of the game's dialogue is sent to the chosen provider, which drafts a first version. The text replaces the field below; nothing is stored until you click Save.

project_setup.title: Project setup
project_setup.subtitle: Pick the Ren'Py game and target language before extracting.
project_setup.target_hint: Used as the generated translation folder name.
project_setup.sdk_desc: Fallback for games shipping no engine this system can run
project_setup.sdk_file_hint: Optional. Select the Ren'Py launcher (renpy.exe or renpy.py).
project_setup.no_blocks_sdk: Check that the game folder is correct.
project_setup.compiled_scripts_only: This game's archives contain only compiled scripts (.rpyc), no source (.rpy) to translate. A decompiler is required before this project can be extracted.
project_setup.only_common_rpy: Only the engine's built-in strings (common.rpy) were extracted, no dialogue from the game itself. Check that this is the game's own project folder, and that game/ holds .rpy files once any archived sources are unpacked.
project_setup.discarded_title: Some files could not be read
project_setup.discarded_message: Ren'Py refused to parse these sources unpacked from the game's archives, so their text is missing from this translation. The game itself still works: it falls back to the compiled version of each one.
project_setup.invalid_project_dir: Selected folder does not look like a Ren'Py project (missing game/ subdir).
project_setup.code_execution_notice: Extraction runs the engine the game ships with, falling back on the Ren'Py SDK. Either way the game's Python code runs, just like starting it would, and the game's own engine is third-party code. Only extract games you would be willing to run yourself.
project_setup.list_subtitle: Resume an existing translation or configure a new project.
project_setup.list_empty: No project yet. Configure a new one to get started.
project_setup.delete_message: This permanently deletes the saved translations and backups for "{name}". The game files are not touched. This cannot be undone.
project_setup.delete_failed: Could not delete the data for "{name}". A file may be in use by another program.
project_setup.existing_tl_desc: The "{language}" translation folder already contains files. What do you want to do?
project_setup.existing_keep_desc: Keep the files as they are and pick up the lines already translated.
project_setup.existing_update_desc: Keep the translations, but let the Ren'Py SDK rebuild the files: texts added by a new game version appear, and texts it removed are dropped.
project_setup.existing_reset_desc: Archive the current files under .rts/backups, then start from scratch. Saved translations are cleared.
project_setup.archive_failed:
Could not archive the existing translation folder: another program is using it. Close the game, your editor, or any file manager or terminal pointing inside game/tl/, then try again.
{error}

review.duplicates_here_tooltip: Same text elsewhere in this file: {here}.
review.duplicates_split_tooltip: Same text: {here} in this file, {elsewhere} in other files.
review.duplicates_notice_one: 1 other line has the same text.
review.duplicates_notice_many: {count} other lines have the same text.
review.copy_source: Copy the source into the translation
review.memory_tooltip: Fill the whole project from the translation memory
review.memory_filled: {n} lines filled from the translation memory, across the whole project.
review.memory_none: No untranslated line of the project matched the translation memory.
review.context_tooltip: Show the lines around this one
review.context_empty: No line around this one in the file.
review.clear_message: This removes all translated text and resets status back to not translated. This cannot be undone.
review.clear_status_unvalidated: Everything not validated by a human
review.duplicates_badge_action: Click to apply this translation to them.
review.duplicates_none: No other line left to receive this translation.
review.file_menu_reveal_failed: Could not open the file manager on this file.

interchange.label: Import / export
interchange.title: Bilingual file
interchange.message: Send the translation out to a proofreader or a CAT tool, and read their file back in. Lines are paired by block identifier, so the file may come back partial or reordered.
interchange.confirm_applicable: {n} translation(s) will be written into the project.
interchange.confirm_flagged: {n} of them fail a quality check (missing tag or variable) and will be written as drafts, not validated.
interchange.confirm_protected: {n} line(s) already validated will be left untouched.
interchange.confirm_stale: {n} line(s) whose source text changed since the export will be skipped.
interchange.confirm_unknown: {n} line(s) are unknown in this project and will be ignored.
interchange.confirm_empty: {n} line(s) carry no translation and will be ignored.
interchange.import_flagged: {n} written as drafts, refused by a quality check
interchange.import_stale: {n} whose source text has changed since the export

export.title: Export translation
export.subtitle: Review the result then generate your archive.
export.error_no_tl_dir: No translation directory found. Run extraction first.
export.incomplete_title: This archive would not be complete
export.untranslated_lines: {n} line(s) have no translation and will ship in the source language.
export.sync_never_saved: No translation has ever been written to the files: the archive will only contain the source language.
export.sync_unsaved_units: {n} translation(s) have not been written to the files and will be missing from the archive.
export.sync_external_edit: The tl/ files were modified outside the application since the last save. Those changes will be lost on the next save.
